title: Later Guptas: more records, rulers, successors

boxes.title: Gupta line & CG II: more
items: After Skandagupta: **Purugupta**, Kumaragupta II, ==**Budhagupta**==, **Narasimhagupta**, Kumaragupta III
CG II killed the **Saka** king first, then Ramagupta (BPSC **2022**)
Navaratnas also: **Dhanvantari**, **Vararuchi** (Prakrit Prakasha), Shanku, Ghatakarpara, Kshapanaka, **Vetalabhatta**
⚠ Fa-Hien = pilgrim, not courtier; never named the king
Kumaragupta I: devotee of **Kartikeya**; Skandagupta coins: **bow and arrow**

boxes.title: Hunas & decline: more
items: Toramana led the ==second Huna invasion==; by **485 CE** also Punjab, Rajasthan, **Kashmir**
Mihirakula also defeated by **Narasimhagupta Baladitya**, Maukharis
⚠ "532 victory pillars" = misread; Yashodharman's rise **undermined** Guptas
Later Guptas' **leaning to Buddhism** cited as a cause
Lost **Roman silk** trade; towns decayed; no **professional army**
No Gupta coins in **Saurashtra**, western Malwa after Skandagupta
